In [[181 BBY/Legends|181 BBY]], a '''space battle''' took place in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], which was to be the final engagement of the [[Dark Jedi Conflict]].

==The battle==
For seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kibh Jeen]] and his [[Kibh Jeen's army|army of pirates]] brought terror to the inhabitants of the Cularin system and eventually, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dispatched two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to the system, to bring the conflict to a resolution. After forging the system's inhabitants and trading concerns into an effective fighting force, they lured Jeen's [[Army/Legends|army]] into a trap. In a fiercely-fought space battle, the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were defeated and Jeen was overwhelmed. The Jedi maneuvered him into a vulnerable position and cut him down, liberating the system from his deprivations.
